_om: Brikka in English (Bumper, rusj.no/en/bumper/) – ludo with British words: counters wait in their base (corner) and race home to the centre; landing on someone «bumps» them back to base. Key = the Norwegian text in spill.js. Shared words come from rusj/kit/tekst.en.json.
Slå seks for å komme ut!: Roll a six to get out!
Seks, men ingen kan flytte: A six, but nothing can move
{n} fram, opp på din egen farge: {n} forward, up onto your own colour
Få alle brikkene dine én runde rundt bre: Get all your counters once round the board and home to the centre – before everyone else.
Slå seks for å komme ut: Roll a six to get out
Brikkene venter i hjørnet ditt. En sekse: Your counters wait in your corner. A six puts a counter on the start square. If you have none out, you get three goes.
Trykk på brikka du vil flytte. Lander du: Tap the counter you want to move. Land on another player's counter and it goes back to base. Everyone is safe on the stars.
Gå en runde rundt, opp på din egen farge: Go once round, up onto your own colour and into the centre. The first to get every counter home wins!
En sekser gir et ekstra kast (det kan sk: A six gives you an extra roll (you can turn that off when you get ready).
Kan bare én brikke flytte, flytter den s: If only one counter can move, it moves by itself.
Mobilen kan ta de ledige plassene – også: The phone can take the empty seats – even when you play on your own.
Trykket på feil brikke? «Angre» tar trek: Tapped the wrong counter? ‘Undo’ takes the move back, right up to the next roll.
og knuff de andre hjem!: and bump the others back to base!
On your own? Then you play against the phone.
Pass the phone round the table.
Hvor mange plasser mobilen tar: How many seats the phone takes
The phone takes the empty seats.
Mobilen tar de ledige plassene – de hete: The phone takes the empty seats – they're called {navn} 🤖.
Mobilen tar de ledige plassene – den het: The phone takes the empty seat – it's called {navn} 🤖.
Seks gir et ekstra kast: A six gives an extra roll
Roll a six and you roll again.
You need the exact number to get home.
Two counters each instead of four.
Begge brikkene i mål – mobilen var heldi: Both counters home – the phone got lucky this time. Rematch?
Alle fire brikkene i mål – mobilen var h: All four counters home – the phone got lucky this time. Rematch?
Alle fire brikkene i mål. Godt jobba!: All four counters home. Well done!
Whoever has got furthest is crowned the winner.
